name: dumbbell seated revers grip concentration curl
description: Seated with your elbow against your thigh, you curl a dumbbell with an overhand grip. It targets the forearm and the upper arm flexors.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet wide and a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace that elbow against the inside of your thigh, palm facing down.
Curl the dumbbell up, keeping your wrist straight.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
